meta.title: What if listening never brings agreement? | Prayer for the One I Cannot Persuade
meta.description:
A spoken prayer for the end of a conversation that did not bring two people to the same place. It offers words for refusing without contempt, leaving a disagreement plain, and carrying away a truer account of the other.

A prayer for disagreement that remains after honest listening, asking for accuracy, restraint, and care without requiring agreement or renewed trust.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-one-i-cannot-persuade

0:00 I
0:35 II
1:12 III

copy.hook: You listened closely and still did not agree. A prayer for keeping their words true, and for counting the absent, when understanding doesn't end in agreement.

copy.alt: In a deep indigo and violet void, a small gold-white light stands between two large, slightly turned lattices of fine overlapping circles. A vast radiant centre then descends and lights both lattices evenly, with a dim rose point glowing nearby.
